candidate.answerReason: The exponent must satisfy \(|a|=1\), so \(a=1\) or \(a=-1\). The nonzero-coefficient condition excludes \(a=1\), leaving \(a=-1\).

methods.label: Check the exponent and coefficient
methods.explanation: A linear function requires the exponent of \(x\) to be \(1\), so \(|a|=1\), giving \(a=\pm1\). Also, \(a-1\neq0\), so \(a\neq1\). Therefore, \(a=-1\).
